description: Run read-only ClickHouse SQL over a project's Replo analytics for traffic, conversion, revenue, and session-level questions. No saved Insights report is required. Use this for ad hoc questions or when list_insights_reports finds no relevant report; an empty report list does not mean analytics are unavailable. Queryable public tables are session_attribution, events_computed, currency_exchange_rates, daily_page_rollups, daily_namespace_rollups, daily_namespace_purchase_rollups, benchmark_comparison, benchmark_trend, daily_category_benchmarks, daily_namespace_benchmark_profiles, benchmark_brand_metrics, daily_namespace_benchmark_rollups, and benchmark_namespace_domain. Only SELECT/WITH queries are accepted, and project-scoped tables are automatically restricted to the requested project and its authorized same-workspace, same-store siblings. Table columns and external metric views are listed in the query input schema. Also supports connected external metrics through those parameterized views. Check get_integration_status before querying; external data can be cached for eight hours and an empty result does not prove zero activity. Use provider tools for discovery or provider-native reports.

query.description:
Run a read-only analytics query for a project.

Rules:
- Use SELECT or WITH queries only.
- Do not add project or namespace filters; project scoping is enforced server-side.
- Use session_attribution(since, until) for cross-project session and attributed revenue; stored computed metrics and page rollups are project-local.
- Session revenue repeats across visited pages: deduplicate by subject for totals. Attributed revenue splits credit across eligible pageviews before domain filters.
- Aggregate-state rollup columns must use the matching ClickHouse merge function, such as countMerge, uniqMerge, or sumMerge, and queries must group by selected dimensions.
- Maximum execution time: 60 seconds.
- Maximum result rows: 100000.

Queryable tables, their columns, and the external metric views for connected integrations are listed at https://docs.replo.app/api-reference/analytics-tables.

External metric views take named since/until dates (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); the views that also need settings JSON or another argument say so on that page. Credentials and project scope are injected server-side: never supply auth_token or project_id.
In MCP, call get_integration_status first for connection IDs, setup links, and supported views. Missing or misconfigured integrations can return zero rows: do not report that as measured zero activity. Use provider-specific tools for metric/property discovery and detailed provider-native reports.
External results can be cached for up to eight hours, and report views cap provider results at 10,000 rows; narrow dates or dimensions if exceeded. Match currencies, reporting timezones, and attribution definitions before combining sources.

Queryable tables:
Parameterized view: session_attribution(since='YYYY-MM-DD', until='YYYY-MM-DD'), inclusive UTC dates. Computes USD purchase, session, and equal-pageview attributed revenue across authorized sibling projects within that window, before domain filters. Cart/checkout views receive no attribution. Deduplicate sessionRevenueUsd by subject before summing. Inherits source row policies. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
session_attribution (
  subject UUID,
  date DateTime64(3),
  name LowCardinality(String),
  domain String,
  path String,
  title String,
  purchaseRevenueUsd Float64,
  sessionRevenueUsd Float64,
  sessionPurchaseCount UInt64,
  attributedRevenueUsd Float64
)
```

Raw events with project-local computed session metrics. Use session_attribution for revenue across linked projects. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
events_computed (
  subject UUID,
  date DateTime64(3),
  name LowCardinality(String),
  path String,
  domain String,
  currencyCode String,
  subjectPurchaseSum Float64,
  subjectPurchaseCount Float64,
  subjectPurchaseFraction Float64,
  subjectPurchaseFractionalSum Float64,
  title String
)
```

Currency exchange rates for multi-currency reporting. Project scoped: no.
```sql
currency_exchange_rates (
  date Date,
  code String,
  rate Float32
)
```

Pre-aggregated daily page metrics by day, domain, path, and UTM source. Revenue/conversion attribution is project-local; use session_attribution across linked projects. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
daily_page_rollups (
  day Date,
  domain String,
  path String,
  utm_source String,
  views_state AggregateFunction(count),
  unique_sessions_state AggregateFunction(uniq, UUID),
  converting_sessions_state AggregateFunction(uniq, UUID),
  fractional_conversions_state AggregateFunction(sum, Float64),
  fractional_revenue_usd_state AggregateFunction(sum, Float64),
  session_conversions_state AggregateFunction(sum, UInt64),
  session_revenue_usd_state AggregateFunction(sum, Float64)
)
```

Pre-aggregated daily project traffic metrics by day and UTM source. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
daily_namespace_rollups (
  day Date,
  utm_source String,
  views_state AggregateFunction(count),
  unique_sessions_state AggregateFunction(uniq, UUID),
  converting_sessions_state AggregateFunction(uniq, UUID)
)
```

Pre-aggregated daily purchase metrics by day and UTM source. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
daily_namespace_purchase_rollups (
  day Date,
  utm_source String,
  purchase_count_state AggregateFunction(count),
  total_revenue_usd_state AggregateFunction(sum, Float64),
  unique_purchasing_sessions_state AggregateFunction(uniq, UUID)
)
```

Parameterized view: benchmark_comparison(window_days=1|7|30|90, since='YYYY-MM-DD', until='YYYY-MM-DD', channel='all'|'affiliate'|'email_sms'|'ai_assistant'|'paid_social'|'paid_search'|'organic_social'|'other_tagged'|'organic_search'|'direct'|'referral', device='all'|'mobile'|'tablet'|'desktop', by_location=0|1, by_price_tier=0|1). One row per day and metric: this project's own value over the window next to anonymized peers in the deepest cohort that passes (10+ brands, not low confidence). It keeps the asked-for axes and the narrowest category it can, trying country, then sub-region, then region at each category level, then drops price tier, then location. Price tiers are p0_25, p25_50, p50_75, p75_100: quartiles of peer brands' 90-day AOV in the root category; a brand with under 30 orders in 90 days has none. A brand in the top 10% or top 1% is compared within p90_100 or p99_100 when that band has enough brands. Metrics: sessions, pages_per_session, add_to_cart_rate, checkout_rate, conversion_rate, orders, revenue_usd, aov_usd, revenue_per_session_usd. days_covered is how many of the window's days have data: fewer than window_days means history is shorter than the window or the project had no sessions on some days. Peer columns are NULL when no cohort passes. Inherits source row policies. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
benchmark_comparison (
  date Date,
  metric String,
  window_days UInt16,
  days_covered UInt16,
  channel String,
  device String,
  my_value Nullable(Float64),
  peer_blended Nullable(Float64),
  peer_p25 Nullable(Float64),
  peer_median Nullable(Float64),
  peer_p75 Nullable(Float64),
  peer_p90 Nullable(Float64),
  peer_brands UInt32,
  confidence String,
  compared_category String,
  compared_location String,
  compared_price_tier String,
  comparison_level String,
  my_price_tier String,
  my_aov_90d_usd Float64,
  my_location String
)
```

Parameterized view: benchmark_trend(since, until, channel, device, by_location, by_price_tier, ma_days, ema_days). benchmark_comparison over 1-day windows plus moving averages per metric: my_sma and peer_sma over the last ma_days days, my_ema and peer_ema with an ema_days half-life. Days without a value are skipped, not counted as 0. Inherits source row policies. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
benchmark_trend (
  date Date,
  metric String,
  my_value Nullable(Float64),
  peer_blended Nullable(Float64),
  peer_median Nullable(Float64),
  peer_p25 Nullable(Float64),
  peer_p75 Nullable(Float64),
  peer_brands UInt32,
  compared_category String,
  my_sma Nullable(Float64),
  peer_sma Nullable(Float64),
  my_ema Nullable(Float64),
  peer_ema Nullable(Float64)
)
```

Anonymized daily peer statistics per cohort, readable across projects. One row per snapshot_date, window_days (1, 7, 30, 90), vertical, category_key (an industry path such as 'Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining', or '' for the whole vertical), channel, device (mobile, tablet, desktop), location_key (the brand's home location (location path such as '/Europe/Western Europe/Germany', or '' for everywhere), price_tier (p0_25, p25_50, p50_75, p75_100, plus the overlapping top bands p90_100 and p99_100) and metric; 'all' (or '') on an axis means not cut by it. blended is pooled across brands and one large brand can move it; p25 to p90 are brand-level quantiles. Rows need 10 brands. confidence is high, medium or low from the relative standard error: never show low rows to customers. Query with FINAL. Project scoped: no.
```sql
daily_category_benchmarks (
  snapshot_date Date,
  window_days UInt16,
  vertical LowCardinality(String),
  category_level UInt8,
  category_key String,
  channel LowCardinality(String),
  device LowCardinality(String),
  location_level UInt8,
  location_key String,
  price_tier LowCardinality(String),
  metric LowCardinality(String),
  brands UInt32,
  blended Float64,
  p25 Float64,
  p50 Float64,
  p75 Float64,
  p90 Nullable(Float64),
  mean Float64,
  stddev Float64,
  rse Float64,
  confidence LowCardinality(String)
)
```

This project's brand (root domain) and its value on every benchmark axis per day: vertical, category_path, location_path, 90-day AOV and orders, price tier, top bands (p90_100, p99_100) it's in, and its root category's tier boundaries (tier_p25_usd to tier_p99_usd, NULL until the category has enough priced peers). Query with FINAL. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
daily_namespace_benchmark_profiles (
  snapshot_date Date,
  brand String,
  vertical LowCardinality(String),
  category_path Array(String),
  country_code LowCardinality(String),
  location_path Array(String),
  aov_90d_usd Float64,
  orders_90d UInt64,
  price_tier LowCardinality(String),
  top_bands Array(String),
  tier_p25_usd Nullable(Float64),
  tier_p50_usd Nullable(Float64),
  tier_p75_usd Nullable(Float64),
  tier_p90_usd Nullable(Float64),
  tier_p99_usd Nullable(Float64)
)
```

Parameterized view: benchmark_brand_metrics(start='YYYY-MM-DD', end='YYYY-MM-DD'). This project's brand totals per as_of day, 1/7/30/90-day window, channel and device ('all' included on both), as used for its benchmarks. days_covered is how many of the window's days have data. Prefer benchmark_comparison. Inherits source row policies. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
benchmark_brand_metrics (
  as_of Date,
  window_days UInt16,
  days_covered UInt16,
  brand String,
  channel String,
  device String,
  sessions UInt64,
  page_views UInt64,
  add_to_cart_sessions UInt64,
  checkout_sessions UInt64,
  purchase_sessions UInt64,
  orders UInt64,
  revenue_usd Float64
)
```

This project's daily benchmark inputs by session channel and device, built from each session 3 hours after it starts (bots excluded). Each session is on exactly one row, so sum() the counts across rows and days. revenue_usd is converted at the purchase day's rate. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
daily_namespace_benchmark_rollups (
  day Date,
  channel LowCardinality(String),
  device LowCardinality(String),
  sessions UInt64,
  page_views UInt64,
  add_to_cart_sessions UInt64,
  checkout_sessions UInt64,
  purchase_sessions UInt64,
  orders UInt64,
  revenue_usd Float64
)
```

The root domain this project is benchmarked as: the one its pages got the most views on in the last 30 days. Query with FINAL. Project scoped: yes.
```sql
benchmark_namespace_domain (
  root_domain String,
  views_30d UInt64,
  updated_at DateTime
)
```

External metric views: triplewhale_metrics_daily, triplewhale_metrics_totals, triplewhale_metrics_list, contentsquare_metrics_daily, contentsquare_metrics_totals, contentsquare_metrics_list, mixpanel_metrics_daily, mixpanel_metrics_totals, mixpanel_metrics_list, lifetimely_metrics_daily, lifetimely_metrics_totals, lifetimely_metrics_list, faire_metrics_daily, faire_metrics_totals, faire_metrics_list, alia_metrics_daily, alia_metrics_totals, alia_metrics_list, intelligems_metrics_daily, intelligems_metrics_totals, intelligems_metrics_list, intelligems_experience_metrics_daily, intelligems_experience_metrics_totals, intelligems_experience_metrics_list, meta_ads_ad_daily, meta_ads_campaign_daily, replo_roi_monthly, shopify_sales_monthly, google_analytics_report, google_search_console_report.
